Attach pixel-noise stereo uncertainty to a reconstructed 3D fish path

Source: R/stereo-uncertainty.R
aqt_reconstruction_pixel_uncertainty.Rd

This function requires raw 2D view observations, their verified correspondences already stored in the reconstructed object, and its original non-refractive camera rig. Returns the same 3D trajectories with conditional uncertainty columns. Identity and calibration errors remain excluded.

Usage

aqt_reconstruction_pixel_uncertainty(
  reconstructed,
  view_a,
  view_b,
  sigma_px = 1,
  draws = 300L,
  seed = 1001L,
  level = 0.95
)

Arguments

reconstructed

Output of aqt_reconstruct_3d().

view_a, view_b

Original camera-local 2D tracks.

sigma_px

Assumed camera-specific localization SD in pixels.

draws

Number of Monte Carlo replicates.

seed

Seed without changing external R random state.

level

Equal-tail interval central mass.

Value

3D aqt_tracks with estimated conditional uncertainty fields.
